QA - Vehicle returns to service while its category-A defect is only resolved, in Vehicles

*Steps to Reproduce:*
# As the driver, report a category-A defect on FK22 DEF
# As the transport manager, triage it and raise a job card
# As the technician, start work and mark it resolved
# As the transport manager, return FK22 DEF to service

*Actual Result:*
FK22 DEF is back in service. The vehicle is Roadworthy although its category-A defect is Resolved, not Closed.

*Expected Result:*
FK22 DEF can't return to service: category-A defect <ID> is not closed. The vehicle stays VOR.
